thread:
Sara (support): Hey team — customer reported a flapping SCIM sync during yesterday's window, plus missing audit rows for some deprovisions. They also saw a bunch of 502/503s from the /provision endpoint.
Akash (eng): Noted. Which customer and timeframe? Any repro steps from them?
Sara (support): Tenant: acme-industries, window: 2026-02-27 22:10–22:40 UTC. They attached a curl trace and said provisioning hung then retried.
Sara (support): curl: `POST /v1/provision sync` -> got 502, then 504s. Body included SCIM patch payloads.
Rory (sre): Pulling infra logs now. Do we have request IDs from the customer?
Sara (support): They gave request-id header `x-rw-req: rw-046bf9a2`. Also saw `kms-decrypt failed` in their app logs around same time.
Akash (eng): Hmm kms-decrypt… could be a transient key-unavailable during a rotation. Any KMS key rotation events in platform logs?
Lina (security): I queried rotations: there was a scheduled rotation for the legacy-provisioner key at 2026-02-27 22:05 UTC, but it reported success. Need to check HSM console for noisy failures.
Rory (sre): Fetching node logs and the gateway traces. If the KMS client returned a 5xx, the service might have bubbled 502.
Rory (sre): quick grep from node: `2026-02-27T22:12:03Z WARN kms: decrypt attempt failed: err=timeout` then `2026-02-27T22:12:04Z ERROR provisioner: upstream error -> 502`.
Akash (eng): That matches. Repro path: trigger SCIM deprovision that calls kms.Decrypt(token) -> if decrypt times out, we currently retry with exponential backoff but still surface 502 to API. Need failing test.
Sara (support): Customer says some users were deprovisioned but audit logs for those IDs are missing from retention export. They need logs for compliance (90-day retention).
Lina (security): Missing audit rows could be due to partial transaction on provisioner side if the operation errored after KMS decrypt but before audit write. We need full tracing: span around decrypt->audit-write.
Akash (eng): I'll add extra instrumentation to mark the audit write outcome and whether decrypt succeeded. For immediate triage, can we ask SRE for a manual audit export for that tenant/time range?
Rory (sre): Yes — can run ad-hoc export. Will include gRPC trace IDs and node IDs. ETA ~30m. @deploy-bot can you stash the relevant logs to the secure bucket? :truck:
deploy-bot: Job queued -> exporting logs for tenant=acme-industries start=2026-02-27T22:00 end=2026-02-27T22:45. destination=gs://redwood-private/audit-exports/1987654321-acme.tar.gz
audit-bot: Export job completed: size=4.6MB sha256=7c9f2... available for 7 days.
Sara (support): Thanks — I downloaded and verified customer-supplied user IDs 5132, 5133 are present in request logs but missing from audit_events table for that timeframe.
Lina (security): That's consistent with a race where decrypt succeeded but our write to audit-events rolled back or never committed. Check DB transaction logs around sequence 1122334.
Akash (eng): I found a repro locally: simulate KMS timeout after decrypt success path -> audit write attempted but DB connection pool was exhausted (max open connections hit), causing write failures that we mark but don't retry.
Rory (sre): Why was pool exhausted? Any spikes in connections?
Akash (eng): There was a surge of long-running KV-cache loads earlier that day; one node had many stuck goroutines holding DB conns. We'll patch to close connections on timeout paths.
Lina (security): For compliance request: we should provide the exported logs, a timeline of events, and a statement about audit row gaps and remediation steps. Also confirm if any keys were compromised (unlikely — rotation success).
Rory (sre): Confirmed no unauthorized key usage. HSM audit shows successful rotate and allowed calls; timeouts were due to transient network latency to HSM cluster region.
Sara (support): Next actions for support: send acme the exported bundle, timeline, and ETA for a permanent fix.
Akash (eng): I'll open PR with fix (close conns on timeout + better retries for audit write). Link after I push.
Akash (eng): PR -> https://stash/redwood/infra/+/PR-4521 (adds metrics and retry for audit write).
Lina (security): I'll draft compliance note and confirm retention export for the missing IDs.
Rory (sre): I'll follow up with HSM provider for network stability during that window.
Sara (support): Copy that. I'll message the customer with the bundle and quick summary, and route to security for formal attestation.
Sara (support): customer-facing note: "We found transient KMS timeouts during your provisioning window which led to partial failures before audit writes completed. We've exported your request traces and are restoring missing audit events where possible; engineering is patching retry/cleanup logic to prevent recurrence." :white_check_mark:
Akash (eng): marking as P1 internal ticket -> RW-4209. Will include regression tests.
Rory (sre): closing loop here, will post follow-up if HSM provider finds infra root cause.
Sara (support): thanks everyone, keeping thread open until remediation confirmed.
